tests.name: New user can sign up and lands on a funded dashboard
tests.summary:
Created an account using the name Kane Tester, email kanew9ff8a@mlyfo.app, and username kanew9ff8a.
Confirmed that @kanew9ff8a was available before completing registration.
Entered the password and created the account successfully.
The account page welcomed Kane and showed a wallet balance of $500.00.

tests.name: New user can sign up and lands on a funded dashboard
tests.summary:
You asked to create an account for Kane Tester using the provided email address, username, and password.
Entered the registration details and confirmed that @kanew9fdp7 was available.
Created the account successfully and reached the welcome page for Kane.
The new account shows a wallet balance of $500.00.

tests.name: Split a $236 bill four ways and get a link per person
tests.summary:
Created the requested split for “Kane dinner w9f800” with a total of $236, shared among zoya, kabir, sofia, and the creator.
The form calculated the split as 4 people at $59.00 each.
Created the split successfully; it is listed as “1 of 4 paid.”
Each of zoya, kabir, and sofia has a $59.00 amount and an available Copy link button.

tests.name: Shield blocks a look-alike of a saved contact's address
tests.summary:
Opened the sign-in area and navigated to the Shield page.
Entered the provided wallet address and checked it.
The result marked the address as “Blocked” and warned that it looks like Ada’s saved address but is not.

tests.name: Shield blocks a look-alike of a saved contact's address
tests.summary:
The requested sign-in action was completed, then the Shield page was opened.
Entered the provided wallet address and selected “Check address.”
The result marked the address as “Blocked” and warned that it looks like Ada’s saved address but is not.

tests.name: A payment over the spend limit waits for password confirmation
tests.summary:
You asked to send $150.00 to @ada for rent using the message "pay @ada 150 for rent."
The payment was initiated, and the confirmation showed "Confirm $150.00 to @ada" along with a notice that it was over the $100.00 per-payment limit.
The password was entered and the payment was confirmed.
The payment completed successfully: $150.00 was sent to @ada and delivered to their balance.

tests.name: Shield flags a fake Phantom airdrop link as dangerous
tests.summary:
Entered https://phantorn-airdrop.app/claim into the link-check field and ran a quick check.
The scan marked the link as Dangerous.
The listed reasons included that the address imitates Phantom.

tests.name: Shield flags a fake Phantom airdrop link as dangerous
tests.summary:
The requested link, https://phantorn-airdrop.app/claim, was entered into the link-check field and checked.
The scan classified the link as Dangerous.
The listed reasons stated that the address imitates Phantom.

tests.name: Shield refuses to save a look-alike of a saved person
tests.summary:
Selected the “Any wallet” option on the People page.
Added Ada with the provided wallet address; the page confirmed “Saved Ada.”
Tried to add Ada new with the second provided address; the page reported that it was not saved because it looked like Ada’s saved address.
Confirmed that Ada new was not added to the people list.

tests.name: Paying a name that is both a saved person and another user asks who you meant
tests.summary:
You asked to send $5.00 to Semi with the note “coffee.”
Entered “pay semi 5 for coffee” and selected the $5.00 payment option.
When asked which Semi was intended, selected “Your contact Semi.”
The payment was completed and the page confirmed: “Sent $5.00 to Semi.”

tests.name: A payment gives a receipt with an ID and a public receipt page
tests.summary:
You asked to open the Receipt link in Recent activity.
Opened the receipt page for the payment.
The receipt confirms that $10.00 was paid to @kabir and shows receipt ID MLY-GC84-HUPJ.

tests.name: A payment gives a receipt with an ID and a public receipt page
tests.summary:
You asked to open the Receipt link in Recent activity.
Opened the receipt page and confirmed that it records a $10.00 payment to @kabir.
The receipt ID shown was MLY-8D4W-9GDC, which begins with “MLY-”.

tests.name: The Android keyboard hands a copied address to Shield
tests.summary:
You asked to sign in and check the supplied wallet address.
The site opened the Shield page with AdaK9zXw2LmQ8rTvB3nYc7HsP4kJe6FgD1oWu5Ra2Fx entered in the address field.
The check marked the address as “Blocked” and warned that it looks like Ada’s saved address but isn’t.

tests.name: Shield blocks a look-alike of a saved Ethereum and Base address
tests.summary:
You asked to sign in and check the specified wallet address.
The sign-in button was selected, then the address-check page was opened with 0x7a3f9cE5b801Dd3fA7426C9e0B1f8a5d3e27c4b9.
The address field contained the requested address, and the result marked it as Blocked.
The result stated that the address looks like Ada (Base)’s saved address but is not, with the network shown as Ethereum · Base.

tests.name: Shield blocks a look-alike of a saved Ethereum and Base address
tests.summary:
Completed the requested Sign in action and opened the Shield address-check page.
The address field contained 0x7a3f9cE5b801Dd3fA7426C9e0B1f8a5d3e27c4b9.
The check marked the address as Blocked and warned that it looks like Ada (Base)’s saved address but is not.

tests.name: The Android page offers the app install and a safe keyboard download
tests.summary:
Opened the Mlyfo web manifest at the requested address.
Confirmed the manifest identifies the app as “Mlyfo” and uses the “standalone” display mode.
The Mlyfo page content also showed the Android keyboard download option, Chrome installation guidance, privacy statements, and a SHA-256 download fingerprint.
